notes: After repeating R&D runs that could only see the same top card, the Runner clicked for credits for seven straight turns up to 38 credits and never ran the advancing remote, so the Corp scored 7 points unopposed.
Efficient scoring out of one iced remote with sensible economy; the only slips were naked Nico Campaign and Regolith that got trashed cheaply, plus a few low-value credit clicks.
The Runner never made a single run all game and clicked for credits up to 51 while the Corp scored four agendas from one remote; there was no coherent plan.
The Corp left R&D unprotected all game while a broke Runner ran it four times a turn, and sat on up to 37 credits drawing and discarding instead of icing it; it lost to four R&D steals.

A slow, broke start spent mostly on clearing 8 tags, then solid remote pressure with Paperclip and Hippo won the game; it wasted credits on repeated Paperclip heap installs and ignored a trashable naked Marilyn Campaign while rich.

For about 20 turns the Corp clicked for credits up to 47 while discarding every turn and rotting Degree Mill, Beale and Bellona in a lightly iced HQ, never installing agendas in its iced remote until far too late.

The Runner built economy too passively, clicking for credits at 20+ while the Corp scored Beale from its remote, and spent a whole turn clearing tags; after that, HQ pressure with Aumakua was strong and won.

After an early GFI steal the Runner clicked for credits up to 34 for five turns, declined to pay 1 credit through Pop-up Window or boost link against Resistor, and installed Femme Fatale without using it while the Corp scored 7 points.

The Corp never installed an agenda after its first remote, then spent 30+ turns paying 2 credits a turn on a futile repeated 'trash DDoS' action and clicking for 1-credit gains, discarding agendas into open Archives until it decked.
Clean play overall: it scored Breaking News fast, used Cobra on R&D well, and scored GFI and two Beales out of a two-ice remote; it ran a little thin on credits late.

It won quickly from iced remotes but never put ice on R&D while the Runner ran it four times every turn (luckily losing only a Hostile Takeover), and it landed Hard-Hitting News for 4 tags with no follow-up.
A sensible R&D lock with Houdini through Pop-up Window won the game; there was an early broke stretch spent clearing tags (Temujin got trashed) and a pointless tagged facecheck of HQ into IP Block.

A decent start (fast AstroScript) gave way to five turns of clicking for credits up to 23 while discarding, never reinforcing an R&D protected only by an Enigma that Yog.0 broke for free; it lost to repeated R&D steals.
The Runner ran into a rezzed Hagen it could never break about 25 times, repeated same-turn R&D runs that could only see the same top card, and never drew, gained credits or built a rig all game.

Against a collapsed Corp it won by repeatedly checking Archives, but it was slow to apply pressure: it played Calling in Favors, Legwork and Information Sifting into nothing/an empty HQ and rarely hit R&D while the Corp had no money to rez.

It used Biotic Labor just to click for credits, sat on 15-24 credits for turns without installing agendas, looped Archived Memories pointlessly for two turns, and left Efficiency Committee and Vitruvius in Archives for the Runner to steal.

The Runner ran into the known Urtica Cipher in Server 1 three times, losing Carmen, Mayfly and Sure Gamble to net damage, and its economy sat at 0-3 credits so it never contested the scoring remote behind Bran.

Ark Lockdown did nothing, it played Biotic Labor only to click for credits, and Architect overwrites pushed agendas into an open Archives; with Corporate Sales Team also stolen from a naked remote, it lost on turn 7.

It won by out-econing a passive Runner, but left an advanced Elective Upgrade behind one ice where it got stolen, burned Efficiency Committee counters just to click for credits, and sat on 20+ credits and 8-11 cards for several turns without advancing.

It spent all its money clearing tags, then ran R&D four times a turn at 0-2 credits (re-accessing the same top card) without ever gaining credits, trashing the Corp's economy assets, or being able to contest the scoring remote.
